svg.title: One cycle of the body at four brightnesses, and the harmonics of a 1 kHz brightness at two pitches
svg.text: bright_hz turns the sine into a saw whose harmonics fade above it, by the same Hz at every pitch
0, a sine: 0% of the power above 150 Hz
200 Hz: 5% of the power above 150 Hz
1000 Hz: 15% of the power above 150 Hz
5000 Hz: 21% of the power above 150 Hz
